beginner.title: Get started with Elastic Security
beginner.outcome: You can: set up Elastic Security, find your way around and finish a first small task
beginner.practice: Complete the official getting-started guide, then one small real task from your work

beginner.title: Lab and legal basics
beginner.outcome: You can: use Elastic Security safely and legally
beginner.practice: Set up a practice lab and write a scope statement

beginner.title: Core use
beginner.outcome: You can: perform the main task of Elastic Security in a lab

intermediate.title: Analyse findings
intermediate.outcome: You can: interpret results and reduce false positives
intermediate.practice: Triage findings from a lab run

intermediate.title: Report clearly
intermediate.outcome: You can: write reports people act on

intermediate.title: Signature skills in Elastic Security
intermediate.outcome: You can: use the features that make Elastic Security distinctive
intermediate.practice: Use each of these features once on a real piece of work

expert.title: Advanced Elastic Security
expert.outcome: You can: use Elastic Security's advanced capabilities with confidence
expert.practice: Complete a project that needs at least two of these advanced capabilities

expert.title: Automate and integrate
expert.outcome: You can: use Elastic Security in a mature security programme

expert.title: Integrate Elastic Security into your workflow
expert.outcome: You can: connect Elastic Security with the other tools you use
expert.practice: Connect Elastic Security to one other tool you use and remove one manual step

expert.title: Lead and teach others
expert.outcome: You can: set standards and teach others to use Elastic Security well
expert.practice: Write a one-page "how we use Elastic Security" guide and teach it to one person

expert_validation.note: Generated from the archetype template plus tool-specific signature skills; to be reviewed by a practitioner.
